capabilities.description: Defines an Ideal Customer Profile: firmographics, persona, trigger events, disqualifiers.
Drafts a personalized cold email or LinkedIn message under 150 words with one CTA.
Builds a curiosity-first response to a stated objection (budget, competitor, timing, price).
Drafts a proposal: problem, solution, outcomes, investment, next steps.
Reviews a deal against pipeline stage exit criteria and flags the next required action.
